what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Bhutan, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2025, the latest year with a figure, IDMC recorded 138 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Bhutan list floods.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Bhutan.

when.text: IDMC records new displacements by disasters year by year, starting in 2011.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Bhutan.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
